advisoryFindings.title: Add lower-bound non-two-column case
advisoryFindings.improvement: Add a one-column Table rejection case alongside the existing three-column rejection case.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The current test covers the required non-two-column error category with a three-column table, but a one-column boundary case would reduce the risk of an implementation only rejecting tables with more than two columns.

advisoryFindings.title: Tighten unsupported format error assertion
advisoryFindings.improvement: Assert that the error message indicates the format is unsupported as well as naming the value, for example by matching both unsupported/format wording and grid.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The current assertion verifies that the unsupported value is named and that an error is thrown, which gives corresponding coverage, but a stricter message assertion would better capture the explicit-error intent.
